title: OrangeCrab rev 0.2.1 ECP5 DDR3

source.name: OrangeCrab rev 0.2.1 ECP5 DDR3
source.scope: All named DDR signal nets incident to CPU or RAM, including passive endpoints. Power, VREF, ZQ and unconnected nets excluded. Existing traces, vias and zones removed. Board uses edge bounding box. No timing or impedance constraints invented.
notes: These are the captured routing inputs, not newly simplified two-chip layouts.
KiCad pad primitives are retained as separate obstacles; some package footprints contain multiple primitives per ball.
Bus metadata restricts source signal layers only; no timing, skew, impedance or differential-pair constraints are invented.
Every source footprint retained; graphics-only references are given unique TSX names.
All connected copper pads and one-terminal nets retained, including power, VREF and ZQ.
No source track, via, copper zone, filled polygon or saved route is imported.
Arc outlines and custom pad curves tessellated; soldermask/paste artwork and logos are not recreated.
Native placement and copper-layer count retained. No timing/impedance constraints invented.
